name: Graveyard
desc1: You are standing on a path in the middle of the dreary graveyard.
desc2: There are no headstones here, but from the few tattered mounds in the
desc3: vicinity, you can tell that you are standing over unmarked graves,
desc4: which gives you an uneasy feeling in your stomach. At least you could
desc5: tell who or 'what' was buried in the previous graves.
